title: flydubai Flight 1073
subtitle: Dubai → Tel Aviv, diverted to Tabuk
note: A reconstruction from the aircraft's own ADS-B broadcasts of a serious incident in which everyone aboard landed safely. The take-off roll and the last half hour before landing rest on few positions and are partly reconstructed; what happened in the cockpit has not been officially established.
summary: flydubai 1073, a Boeing 737 MAX 8, from Dubai to Tel Aviv on 30 September 2026.

Over northern Saudi Arabia the aircraft left 34,000 ft without a descent selected and dived steeply. It declared an emergency (7700), then set 7500 (unlawful interference), turned back over Jordan and landed at Tabuk at about 06:45 UTC.
Israeli security officials attributed the emergency to a confrontation between the two pilots. The cause is under investigation.

card.title: flydubai Flight 1073
lines: 30 September 2026 · Boeing 737 MAX 8 A6-FKF, Dubai to Tel Aviv.
It landed on runway 31 at Tabuk at about 06:45 UTC. flydubai said all passengers were safe.
Israeli security officials said the emergency stemmed from a confrontation between the two pilots. Its cause, and whether the dive was deliberate, have not been officially established.

From the aircraft's ADS-B broadcasts as received by adsb.lol (ODbL) and, where no open network heard it, by Flightradar24. The take-off roll and the 15 minutes before the final approach are reconstructed.
